name: 56621 · Bagley, MN
findings: ZIP 56621 (Bagley) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56621 (Bagley) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 56621 (Bagley) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
